name: Tunisie Telecom Data Center Carthage
notes: TT flagship data center in Tunis; operational since June 2014; ISO/IEC 27001 (2016, maintained 2017) plus ISO 27701 and ISO 9001 certifications; hosts IT infrastructure and cloud services. Address from directories (Carthage/Avenue de Carthage area) remains directory-grade; exact commune not confirmed by TT page.

name: Ooredoo Tunisie La Charguia 1 Data Center
notes: Ooredoo Tunisia data center at La Charguia 1, Tunis (WMC press visit 2016-02-19 confirms physical site; technical director Hatem Mestiri). Ooredoo hosting pages are A-grade for service claim that customer data is stored in Ooredoo Tunisia data centers. Capacity/specs not published.

name: DataXion Tunis Data Center
notes: DataXion official page claims the only Tier IV-certified datacenter in Tunisia; markets housing, colocation, cloud (Cloudaxion) and GPU cloud for AI (NVIDIA L40s); celebrated 10 years in May 2026. Facility placed in El Agba/Tunis by DataCenterMap (directory address = C-grade detail). Capacity not published.

name: ATI Data Centers (Tunisie Internet)
notes: ATI states it hosts products/data in ATI data centers and markets housing/colocation in Tunisian datacenters; .tn registry and TunIXP support context. Service existence A; exact facility address (HQ at 13 Avenue Jugurtha, Tunis 1002 is office, not facility) and capacity not published.

name: Syntys Charguia Data Center
notes: Iron Mountain official Syntys joint-venture page lists Tunisia locations: Mghira, Charguia, Manouba, Sidi Rezig, Sousse. Charguia site in Tunis governorate; directory listing corroborates facility name. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ATLAX Tunis Data Center
notes: ATLAX markets Tunisia data-center services; Inflect aggregate profile reports Tunis site at ~1.5 MW. Aggregate-sourced capacity and location (C-grade) pending operator technical sheet.

name: SIBTEL Data Center
notes: SIBTEL announced equipping itself with a new data center (2018); banking-infrastructure context, HQ in Tunis. No IT load or exact address disclosed; assigned to Tunis governorate.

name: CNI Private Cloud (Centre National de l'Informatique)
notes: Public-sector private-cloud platform under Tunisie Digitale 2020; AfDB/MTC procurement route confirms project and award/implementation lead. Likely Tunis hosting but implementation site must be verified separately; CNI El Omrane address is office, not facility.

name: CCK El-Khawarizmi (Centre de Calcul El-Khawarizmi)
notes: Institutional HPC / research computing centre in Tunis (university/research network). Counted as institutional compute, not commercial colocation.

name: Syntys Sidi Rezig Data Center
notes: Syntys/Ooredoo portfolio facility at Sidi Rezig, Megrine, Ben Arous governorate; confirmed as Tunisia location on Iron Mountain official JV page; directory listing gives facility-level detail. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Syntys Mghira Data Center
notes: Syntys/Ooredoo portfolio facility at Mghira/Fouchana industrial area, Ben Arous governorate; confirmed on Iron Mountain official JV page. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Syntys Manouba Data Center
notes: Syntys/Ooredoo portfolio facility in Manouba governorate; confirmed on Iron Mountain official JV page. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SoleCrypt AI Data Center Bizerte
notes: MoU signed 2026-02-02 with Schneider Electric to study/co-develop sustainable AI data centers in Tunisia; DCD/L'Economiste Maghrebin report 20 MW initial AI DC at Parc d'activites economiques de Bizerte (B-grade detail), powered by 60 MW solar (T60, Tozeur - energy asset, not a DC site). Stage stays planned: no construction/permit/grid evidence yet. Bizerte also hosts Orange/Medusa submarine cable landing station (connectivity asset, not a DC).

name: Tunisie Telecom Data Center Kairouan
notes: TT CEO Nizar Bouguila announced (Revue de l'Entreprise interview, reported by WMC/Directinfo 2017-07-11) that TT was finalizing a new data center in Kairouan, modeled on Data Center Carthage with international-standard info-security services. No later status/commissioning source found in this round; current operational status unverified.
